name: Mechanical Keyboard Keychain
description: Compact mechanical keyboard keychain fidget clicker with satisfying tactile Cherry MX blue-style switches. Small enough to fit in your pocket, perfect for stress relief and fidgeting. Translucent smoky housing with LED-lit switches visible inside.
mechanics: 4 keys in a single vertical column. This is a playful fidget toy, not a utility tool; interactions are casual, bouncy, and aimless. The device is operated ONE-HANDED using a loose squeezing motion. The smooth back of the casing rests against the palm. The four fingers (index, middle, ring, pinky) wrap around the front. The fleshy pads of the fingers press directly onto the FLAT TOP FACES of the keycaps (never the sides). When pressed, the keycap visibly plunges ~2mm downward into the translucent housing, fully depressing before instantly springing back up when released.
grip: Wrapped Fidget Grip: The hand forms a loose, relaxed fist around the device. The palm acts as a static backboard. The four fingers curl over the front to act as the actuators, resting directly on the top keycaps. The grip is vertical with the chain dangling. The thumb stays wrapped around the back or side and DOES NOT press the keys.

interaction_patterns.name: The Fidget Wave
interaction_patterns.description: The four fingers sequentially press the keycaps from top to bottom (index, middle, ring, pinky) in a rapid, fluid wave, like drumming fingers idly on a desk. The keys visibly travel up and down like a piston in a continuous, looping rhythm.

interaction_patterns.name: The Anxious Crunch
interaction_patterns.description: A rapid-fire, bouncy squeeze where multiple fingers quickly crunch the keycaps inward at the same time. The motion is fast, erratic, and purely for tactile pleasure. The keys sink deep into the housing and spring back rapidly.

interaction_patterns.name: The Absentminded Hold
interaction_patterns.description: A casual squeeze where a couple of fingers hold the keys fully depressed into the housing while the hand rests idly. The movement feels relaxed, as if the person is focusing on something else.

timing: Burst and Pause: a sequence of 3-4 clicks over ~1.5 seconds (120-140 BPM), followed by a 1-second pause to admire the LED glow or reset finger position. The rhythm is tactile and auditory, driven by the clicky switch sound.
stationary_elements: The palm and back of the hand remain a stable backboard behind the device
The clear plastic housing stays cradled against the palm and does not slide
The wrist stays mostly fixed, only rotating very slightly to catch light
Camera distance remains constant — framing does not zoom in or out

camera_setups.name: POV Vertical
camera_setups.description: Camera at chest height looking down at the left hand. Hand and device occupy 60-80% of frame. Background blurred (shallow depth of field). Handheld with slight breathing motion.

camera_setups.name: Side Profile
camera_setups.description: Camera angled slightly to the side to capture the depth of keycaps and LED glow. Clean domestic background (curtain, door, wall). Extreme close-up.

impossible_interactions: two-handed interaction (holding with one hand, pressing with the other hand's finger)
holding the device horizontally in landscape orientation
pressing the device while it lies flat on a table or surface
holding the device by the metal keychain ring while pressing keys
inverted holding with the keychain ring pointing upward
pressing the side or back of the plastic housing
throwing or flipping the device in the air
large wrist swings that cause the product to rotate dramatically
fingers pressing the sides, edges, or bottom of the keycaps
keys remaining completely stiff or frozen when pressed by a finger
deliberate, slow, calculator-style typing or password-entering motions
using the thumb to press the keys
